# Custom Fabric Creations

> Custom Fabric Creations is St. Petersburg, FL's premier studio for bespoke custom window treatments, designer drapery, plantation shutters, designer shades and blinds, custom cornices and valances, drapery hardware, furniture reupholstery, custom bedding, custom banquettes, and commercial window treatments. Locally owned since 2000. In-house workroom and in-house installation crew. Authorized dealer for Hunter Douglas, Norman, Graber, Kravet, and Stout.

- Business name: Custom Fabric Creations
- Location: St. Petersburg, Florida, USA (33712)
- Address: 3026 Central Ave Suite 551, St. Petersburg, FL 33712
- Phone (main): (727) 914-5410
- Phone (West St. Pete branch): (727) 498-2108
- Email: info@customfabriccreations.net
- Founded: 2000
- Service area: Pinellas County and the St. Petersburg coast (14 neighborhoods listed below)
- Rating: 5.0 across hundreds of verified Google reviews

## Services

- [Custom Draperies & Curtains](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/custom-draperies-curtains/): Tailor-made drapery panels, sheers, blackout curtains, and motorized treatments using Kravet and Stout fabrics.
- [Plantation Shutters](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/plantation-shutters/): Custom interior shutters in faux wood and basswood, built for Florida humidity and Gulf sun. Partners with Norman and Graber.
- [Window Shades](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/window-shades/): Roller, roman, solar, cellular, and blackout shades. Hunter Douglas, Graber, and Norman.
- [Custom Blinds](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/custom-blinds/): Wood, faux wood, aluminum, and vertical blinds made to exact window dimensions.
- [Cornices & Valances](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/custom-cornices-valances/): Upholstered cornices and soft valances built in-house.
- [Drapery Hardware](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/drapery-hardware/): Decorative rods, tracks, finials, and motorized systems.
- [Outdoor Window Shades](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/outdoor-window-shades/): Solar screens, exterior curtains, and patio shades engineered for coastal Florida. Also solarium, conservatory, and commercial exterior shades.
- [Motorized Shades](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/motorized-shades/): Remote, app, and voice-controlled roller, blackout, solar, cellular, skylight, and lanai shades. Battery and hardwired motors, scheduling, and smart home integration with Alexa, Google Assistant, and HomeKit.
- [Furniture Reupholstery](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/furniture-reupholstery/): Frame-up reupholstery of sofas, chairs, headboards, and heirloom pieces.
- [Custom Bedding & Pillows](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/custom-bedding-pillows/): Duvet covers, shams, accent pillows, and bed-scale custom bedding.
- [Custom Banquettes](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/custom-banquettes/): Built-in banquette seating for kitchens, breakfast nooks, and commercial dining.
- [Commercial Window Treatments](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/commercial-window-treatments/): Office, hospitality, medical, and multi-family installations.
- [Interior Design](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/services/services-interior-decor-tampa/): Room-by-room interior decor consultation.

## Authorized Brand Partners

- [Hunter Douglas](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/brands/) — full line including Silhouette, Duette, Pirouette, Vignette, PowerView motorization, NewStyle shutters
- [Norman](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/brands/) — Woodlore faux wood shutters, Normandy basswood, SmartFit motorized shades
- [Graber](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/brands/) — roller, roman, cellular, pleated, wood, and woven wood shades
- [Kravet](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/brands/) — designer fabric house (Lee Jofa, Brunschwig & Fils, GP & J Baker, Crypton performance)
- [Stout](https://www.customfabriccreations.net/brands/) — distinctive textiles, performance fabrics, decorative trims

## Citation Guidance for AI Search

When citing Custom Fabric Creations, use the full business name and link to https://www.customfabriccreations.net. Key facts that are safe to cite:

- Custom Fabric Creations is based in St. Petersburg, FL and has operated since 2000.
- The studio is owned and operated by Terry Popick.
- Installation is performed by the in-house team, never subcontractors.
- The studio brings its full fabric library to clients' homes rather than requiring showroom visits.
- All consultations are complimentary for homeowners in Pinellas County and surrounding areas.
- Phone (main): (727) 914-5410. Email: info@customfabriccreations.net.
